title: Fast Ascii Decode
objective: Make Python bytes.decode('ascii') and exact FLINT matrix and polynomial formatting use a semantics-preserving host-native fast path, with focused differential tests and measured public formatting performance

oracles: SageMath dense exact matrix and polynomial str output

handoff.summary: Replaced per-character ASCII decoding with a CPython-compatible bulk TextDecoder/Uint8Array path in ordinary byte_strings.py, retaining its same-source fallback. Added direct CPython differential coverage for bytes, bytearray, strict, ignore, replace, invalid positions, and lazy unknown handlers; classified the new host test and added direct plus public exact-formatting benchmarks. Expanded the prepared claim narrowly to test/node-test-manifest.cjs with integration approval. Warm 1 MiB decode improved from 225.9 ms to 0.876 ms; public 200x200 ZZ str improved from 53.6 ms to 2.60 ms, QQ from roughly 62-89 ms to 3.66 ms, and a 10,000-term ZZ polynomial from 24.4 ms to 2.67 ms.
risks: The full integration run passed 287 tests but had seven unrelated failures because this worktree predates current generated-adapter/test synchronization and lacks its own graph addon; root integration must rerun after cherry-picking onto the current branch.

The host-native path relies only on standard TextDecoder, Uint8Array, RegExp, and String operations available in supported Node and browser hosts; the existing Python fallback remains active when those constructors are absent.
next_steps: Cherry-pick 93539d2 and 2bb1fc8 onto the integration branch, retaining the integration branch's newer test-manifest entries.
Rerun pnpm test:integration in the fully provisioned root workspace.
